# Questions, Corrections & Feedback

Thank you for visiting **The Key Verse of Every Chapter of the Bible**.

Questions, corrections, and thoughtful feedback about the project are welcome. In particular, feel free to get in touch if you:

- notice a factual, typographical, or formatting error;
- have a question about why a particular key verse was selected;
- have feedback about a chapter insight or book summary;
- have a suggestion for improving the site;
- have a question about citing, sharing, or referencing the project.

## Email

You can contact the project by email:

[Email the Key Verse Bible project](mailto:keyversebibleproject@gmail.com?subject=Key%20Verse%20Bible%20Feedback)

Please include the **Bible book and chapter** in your message when your feedback concerns a specific page.

I read all feedback, but I may not be able to respond individually to every message.

---

Thank you for helping improve this study resource.
